_note: Act III: the climax. Frames. Templates. {UPPERCASE} slots draw a fresh atom each time; {lowercase} slots are the story's own fields ({first}, {place}, {want}...). {the_thing}, {the_someone}, {the_message}, {the_disaster} reuse something an earlier beat introduced: favored when it exists, never used when it doesn't. Tagged entries are favored in those genres. {SLOT:feature} requires a feature (see frames.py); verbs bind to the subject and object around them; {was}/{is} agree with the noun before.
entries: {first} stood before the {rival} with {THING:portable} and finally told the truth about {TOPIC}.
{first} gave up {PRIZE:!inner} to save {CLOSE:human}, and {SOMEONE} watched.

{first} outwitted {SOMEONE} and broke the hold of {VICE}.
